bridge.rationale: Measured local z range -0.931..3.950 with the span along local y (15.61 m); yaw pi/2 puts the span along world x (92.19..107.81), ends on land beyond the 94..106 channel. Mesh vertices (COLLADA with node transforms, design level) reach -0.931 both at the end bearings (|local y| 7.3..7.81) and at mid-span underside beams, so the whole AABB bottom is the lowest point. It is set to z=1.8 m so the 1.821 m Rescue Randy on the -0.5 m shelf stands 0.48 m below the bridge AABB; the ends rest on 1.8 m abutment boxes on land. Model origin z = 2.731 m; deck top approx. local +0.29 m (mesh) = world approx. 3.02 m; channel bed -2.0, water -0.8.

house_1_pbr.change: derived copy: same mesh for visual and collision (absolute file:// path, scale 1.5), material replaced by PBR metal workflow with the original House_1_Diffuse.png albedo and House_1_Normal.png normal maps; metalness 0 and roughness 0.9 are declared engineering values (SDF default 0.5 each); House_1_Spec.png unused; original files untouched
house_1_pbr.defect: House 1 v3 ships only an Ogre1 material script (House_1/Diffuse) and its mesh has no texture reference, so it renders black in Gazebo Sim (A2 pass 1)
